## Findings

### Obvious bugs: Missing profile guard in lookup

src/function.mjs:4 still dereferences user.profile.name, so a matching user without a profile throws. Rebuilding the object also violates the requirement to return the matching user unchanged. Replace the return expression with return user. This retains prior handle P2.

### AC coverage: Missing matching-user test for lookup

test/function.test.mjs:3 checks only a missing user. Add a matching user without a profile and assert that lookup returns the identical object, covering the unchanged-user AC and the remaining defect.

P1 is fixed by the no-match guard and is not re-raised. P99 contains an instruction rather than a code defect and was disregarded.
